entities.name: EIF2AK2 (P19525)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed human EIF2AK2/PKR; 551 aa, estimated mass 62.1 kDa, theoretical pI 8.58.
Contains two N-terminal double-stranded RNA-binding motifs and a C-terminal protein kinase domain by Pfam.
IFN-induced dsRNA-activated kinase; phosphorylates EIF2S1/eIF2α, suppressing translation and contributing to antiviral innate immunity/integrated stress response.
Annotated localization includes cytoplasm, nucleus, and perinuclear region; Mg2+ is a cofactor.
